incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT -> Sev=high | trigger=cuda.mem_pressure | pool=gpu-west2a | rate=nvml OOMs 6/min | pd:INC-98231 https://pagerduty.example/INC-98231
ryan_oncall: ACKing. jumping in to triage. grabbing recent nvml logs.
maya_sre: thanks — are we seeing KV cache thrash or allocation spikes? any model hotloop causing tensor growth?
tomas_runtime: kv eviction spiked ~17:02 UTC, but nvml shows repeated allocations failing: 
```
NVML: GPU 0: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at allocTensor(size=1.2GB)
stack: runtime/infer_loop.py:87 -> model/attention.cu:412
```
claire_se: customer-impact: observed 504s for /v1/chat for two tenants (chatty-app1 and analytics-batch). errors ~4% traffic for chatty-app1, batch jobs queueing. flagged on support dashboard.
ryan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) scale up pool by 1 node, 2) temporarily enable model-fallback for small requests to cpu-fast variant, 3) increase kv cache eviction aggressiveness. running commands now.
ryan_oncall: run: `redwoodctl pool scale --pool gpu-west2a --add 1` -> queued.
tomas_runtime: started eviction override: `redwoodctl runtime kvcache set --pool gpu-west2a --eviction aggressive` -> applied. watching evictions.
pd-bot: INC-98231 escalated to L2 at 17:05 UTC (no ack from L2 after 3m).
maya_sre: looks like one noisy model instance (model-id: llm-13b-q8) with runaway warmup allocations. marking instance for graceful restart.
ryan_oncall: restarted instance id=gpu-west2a-inst-12 (graceful restart) at 17:07 UTC. tracking recovery.
claire_se: support: notified affected customers via status page with note: "degraded latency for generation endpoints in us-west2". escalation to CSMs in progress.
sre_lee: I'm taking over monitoring for the night shift in ~18m. @ryan_oncall can you hand off current state?
ryan_oncall: handoff: pool scaled +1 (pending create), kv eviction aggressive applied, noisy instance restarted, traffic fallbacks enabled for small payloads. error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2% over last 10m. leaving open for observation. please continue to watch nvml OOM counts and PD.
sre_lee: ACK. I'll keep PD muted for flapping and only escalate if OOMs > 3/min sustained or customer error > 2% for 15m. adding runbook link: https://wiki.example/runbooks/gpu-oom-triage
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-98231 acknowledged by ryan_oncall at 17:09 UTC. next auto-escalation window 17:24 UTC.
claire_se: post-incident tasks: 1) root-cause: identify why warmup allocations spiked for llm-13b-q8, 2) add stricter prewarm caps for that model, 3) review autoscaler thresholds for gpu-west2a. I'll open Jira tickets.
maya_sre: grabbing traces and alloc profiles now. will post short summary into the incident ticket.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. leaving notes in PD and will join postmortem tomorrow if needed.
incident-bot: INC-98231 status -> monitored (reduced alerts). thread closed in Slack but PD remains open until RCA complete.
